metadata.title: English Hangman Rounds by CEFR Level
metadata.description: 36 themed hangman rounds of 8 words each. Themes, vocabulary and phrase length are calibrated to each CEFR level, and so are the number of lives and whether the clue is visible from the start.
metadata.framework: CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)

level_settings.lives: Wrong guesses allowed per word (1 to 10). Fewer lives start with more of the drawing already in place.
level_settings.clue: "always" shows the clue from the start; "on-request" hides it until someone presses Show clue.
